tabs.tab_content: Not when it’s done well. We write every message in your voice, keep them short and hand off to a real person when it matters.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need a new CRM?
tabs.tab_content: Not necessarily. We’ll use your current system if it can do the job, or recommend one that can.
Lead replies, reminders, follow-ups, review requests, win-backs and newsletters. Anything repetitive that should happen every time.

tabs.tab_title: Can I change the messages later?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. You can review and edit any message, and we update them as your offers change.

tabs.tab_title: Can I buy Marketing Automation on its own?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every service is delivered as part of a FirstSearch partnership, because marketing automation works best alongside the rest of your marketing system. Your plan includes every service your business needs for one fixed monthly retainer.
